title: Retry the stalled Playwright system-dependency install in CI
description: Twice in four CI-backed stories (TASK-1.7 PR run 44220403675 attempt 1, TASK-1.3 run 44236421395 attempt 1) the 'Install Playwright system dependencies' step stalled on the Ubuntu apt mirror for 19+ minutes and hit the 20-minute job timeout, while the same step normally takes ~30-70 s. Each stall costs a manual cancel/re-run and up to 20 billed minutes on this private repo. Follow-up from TASK-1.7 (J-2-01) and TASK-1.3.

nodes.title: Retry the stalled Playwright system-dependency install in CI
Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Run every check in GitHub Actions on each push and pull request

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the workflow, When the Playwright system-dependency (and browser) install step runs, Then it has a step-level timeout well below the job timeout (e.g. 5 minutes per attempt)
Given the install step fails or times out, When CI continues, Then it retries the install automatically (at least 2 retries) before failing the job
Given all install attempts fail, When the job ends, Then the workflow is reported as failed with a log line naming the install step
Given a normal run, When the install succeeds on the first attempt, Then total job time is not increased by more than 10 seconds
Given the static workflow tests in tests/ci/workflow.test.ts, When they run, Then they assert the timeout and retry are present
